contrasts.speaker: A
contrasts.quote: it doesn't take sponginess to make sponginess
contrasts.explanation: The repeatable phrase summarizes the concrete cake example at E1953–1962. Schmid uses it to question property transmission, then explicitly says he has not established a successful counterexample or refuted the greatness principle at E1971–1977.

contrasts.speaker: B
contrasts.quote: it takes greatness to make greatness
contrasts.explanation: Rasmussen expands this shorthand into a property-grounding principle at E2138–2152 and motivates it through the value of a capacity to produce value at E2161–2177. He acknowledges alternative formulations and limited persuasiveness at E2188–2209, then invites criticism. The disputed premise remains open to assessment.
